channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: Tesla Semi's Series Production Model, Explained by the Engineer Behind It
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Kyle Conner and Tesla Semi program lead Dan Priestley walk through the changes from the early beta fleet to the current series production truck, covering the new 4680 battery pack, MCS 3.2 charging standard, dual-axle drivetrain design, and the 25 kW ePTO port being standardized for electric trailer equipment.

item.title: Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Manthey Kit Sets New EV Record at the Nürburgring
item.dc:creator: Porsche
item.description: On-board footage from Lars Kern's 6:55.533 Nordschleife record lap on April 15, beating the previous electric executive car record by more than nine seconds. The Manthey Kit is the first developed for an electric Porsche and covers aerodynamics, powertrain, brakes, suspension, and wheels.

item.title: Waymo and Zoox Are Competing for the Ride-Hailing Market. The Economics Are Still Being Worked Out.
item.dc:creator: Financial Times
item.description: The FT examines how Waymo and Amazon-owned Zoox are reshaping urban ride-hailing, with Waymo logging 127 million driverless miles with no fatal crashes and robo taxi fares running roughly a third above comparable Uber rides in San Francisco.

item.title: Lexus Reveals the 2027 TZ: A Three-Row Electric SUV Built Around Cabin Silence and V2H Power
item.dc:creator: REC Anything
item.description: Lexus unveiled the 2027 TZ at Toyota's Technical Center in Japan, presenting a three-row BEV with V2H bidirectional charging, a 5.2-second 0-100 km/h time, 3,500 lb towing capacity, and access to the NACS Supercharger network.

item.title: Rivian's CEO on R2, AI-Defined Vehicles, and Why Every Automaker Needs a Software Platform
item.dc:creator: The Electric Duo
item.description: RJ Scaringe speaks at ACT Expo about ramping the $45,000 R2, the $5.8 billion Volkswagen software licensing deal, Amazon's 30,000-plus electric vans, and his argument that a connected, self-driving platform will be a prerequisite for market share by 2035.

item.title: How a Japanese Climate Activist Got 17 Coal Projects Cancelled and What She's Building Next
item.dc:creator: TED
item.description: Kimiko Hirata's multi-year campaign against coal expansion in Japan led to 17 project cancellations totaling 9 gigawatts, Japan's first shareholder climate activism at Mizuho bank, and a new think tank building the affirmative case for 90 percent renewables.

item.title: VW, BMW, and Mercedes Are Running Full Urban Driver Assistance in China. Western Buyers Don't Get It.
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Out of Spec Reviews drives the Volkswagen ID Era 9X through Beijing traffic on the Momenta driver assistance system, which also runs in BMW and Mercedes vehicles in China. The result is comparable to Tesla FSD. Western markets get Travel Assist.

item.title: A Solar EV Charger That Arrives on a Truck, Needs No Foundations, and Pays Back the Hospital That Owns It
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric TECH
item.description: 3TI's Halo FastHub installs at a Manchester hospital in three days with no concrete foundations, solar supplementing 30 to 40 percent of charging, and revenue from electricity sales going back to the hospital that owns the units.

item.title: Ford Is Building a $30,000 Electric Truck Designed to Compete With What China Offers
item.dc:creator: MS NOW
item.description: Ford has revealed a secretly developed $30,000 American-made electric truck with around 300 miles of range, timed as battery costs fall below $100 per kilowatt-hour for the first time and US EV demand rises.

item.title: 2027 Volvo EX60: A Fully New Electric SUV With Up to 400 Miles of Range
item.dc:creator: Doug DeMuro
item.description: Volvo's EX60 is a ground-up electric SUV, 4 inches longer than the XC60, with three trim levels from 370 hp and 310 miles up to 670 hp and 400 miles. NACS is standard, 10 to 80 percent takes around 16 minutes, and US sales start this summer in the mid-to-high $50,000 range.

item.title: Three Cheap EVs, 186 Miles Through Rural Wales: How Did They Hold Up?
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric
item.description: A BYD Dolphin Surf, Citroën eC3, and Leap Motor T03 tackle the A470 from North Wales to Cardiff. All three completed the 186-mile route, but both the BYD and Citroën fell well short of their claimed 100 kW charging peaks in real-world conditions.

item.title: Rivian Is Scaling Its Charging Network Ahead of R2 and Opening It to All EVs
item.dc:creator: Rivian
item.description: The Adventure Network is expanding with taller chargers, longer cables, and pre-wired underground capacity at existing sites, now open to all EV brands. Most sites have around six stalls today, but the groundwork is already done to expand quickly as R2 demand grows.

item.title: CATL's Shenxing Gen 3 Battery Charges From 10 to 80 Percent in Under 4 Minutes
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: CATL's Shenxing Generation 3 LFP pack reaches 10 to 80 percent in 3 minutes 40 seconds and full charge in 6 minutes 27 seconds. Cell resistance is 0.25 milliohms, state of health stays above 90 percent after 1,000 cycles, and cold weather at minus 30 degrees Celsius adds only about 3 minutes.

item.title: Pakistan's Solar Boom Is Shielding Some Homes From Energy Shocks. Not Everyone Can Afford It.
item.dc:creator: DW News
item.description: Grid tariffs rose 155 percent from 2021 to 2024, pushing Pakistan to become the world's largest importer of Chinese solar panels. The government has since taxed panel and battery imports and cut the solar buyback rate by 60 percent, limiting who can access the benefits.

item.title: Three Charger Failures Later, a Naval Engineer Finally Gets His La Mesa EV Circuit Fixed
item.dc:creator: State of Charge
item.description: A 22-year active-duty naval engineer in La Mesa lost three Wallbox chargers to a badly installed 60-amp circuit with nicked wires, the wrong wire type, and an unnecessary junction box. Tom Moloughney and Trout Electric spent 12 hours diagnosing and rebuilding the whole run.

item.title: The Volkswagen Three-Row That Sells in China for $51,000 and Won't Come Here Anytime Soon
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: The ID. Era 9X is a 500-horsepower range-extended three-row EV on an 800V architecture, built through a SAIC-Volkswagen joint venture and selling in China for around $51,000 fully loaded. Out of Spec Reviews and a German EV creator toured the car at the Beijing Auto Show.

item.title: Geely Already Has US Factories, Dealerships, and a Brand That Could Sell Here Tomorrow
item.dc:creator: CNBC
item.description: Through its stakes in Volvo, Polestar, and Lotus, Geely Holding already has US dealership networks, a South Carolina factory, and established supply chains. Analysts identify Zeekr as the most likely next brand entry point for US consumers.

item.title: How Fast Do EV Batteries Actually Degrade, and How to Test One Before You Buy
item.dc:creator: Engineering with Rosie
item.description: A Geotab study of over 20,000 EVs finds average battery capacity loss of 2.3% per year. Engineering with Rosie covers the data, the causes of faster degradation, and two practical tools for checking state of health before buying a used EV.

item.title: A Stripped, Caged, 315-Wide Tesla Model 3 Performance Laps the Nürburgring
item.dc:creator: Misha Charoudin
item.description: A privately built carbon widebody Tesla Model 3 Performance with a full cage, KW two-way competition suspension, StopTech brakes, and 315-section tires laps the Nürburgring in a public trackday session. Misha Charoudin drove it and found a work in progress with genuinely strong brakes.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
